description: A `yield`'s own template uses both the Mustache-partial splice `{{> a}}` and a bare sibling reference `{{a.value}}` to the same effect -- both resolve to `a`'s own value ("A / A"), not only the partial. Fails (renders "A / ") on main, where `yield b`'s own template renders against the composition overlay directly, with no bare-reference fallback at all.
